title: The High Priestly Prayer

questions.question: At the start of His prayer, what did Jesus ask the Father to do for Him?
options: Glorify your Son that the Son may glorify you
Send twelve legions of angels
Deliver him from the hands of the Romans
Give him peace in his hour of suffering
questions.correctAnswer: Glorify your Son that the Son may glorify you
questions.explanation: John 17:1 (ESV): "Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son that the Son may glorify you,"

questions.question: How did Jesus define eternal life in John 17:3?
options: "that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent."
"that they obey all the commandments given through Moses."
"that they remain pure from the corruption of the world."
"that they love one another as I have loved you."
questions.correctAnswer: "that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent."
questions.explanation: John 17:3 (ESV): "And this is eternal life, that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent."

questions.question: Jesus said He glorified the Father on earth by doing what?
options: Having accomplished the work the Father gave him to do
Performing signs that no prophet had done before
Healing every sick person He encountered
Feeding the multitudes with miraculous bread
questions.correctAnswer: Having accomplished the work the Father gave him to do
questions.explanation: John 17:4 (ESV): "I glorified you on earth, having accomplished the work that you gave me to do."

questions.question: Jesus prayed not for the world but for those the Father had given Him. What was His description of those He kept?
options: "I have guarded them, and not one of them has been lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled."
"I have taught them and they believe entirely."
"I have healed them and made them whole."
"I have blessed them with signs and wonders."
questions.correctAnswer: "I have guarded them, and not one of them has been lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled."
questions.explanation: John 17:12 (ESV): "While I was with them, I kept them in your name... I have guarded them, and not one of them has been lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled."

questions.question: What did Jesus ask the Father to use to sanctify His disciples?
options: Your truth; your word is truth
The Holy Spirit dwelling within them
The blood of the Passover lamb
The water of baptism in the Jordan
questions.correctAnswer: Your truth; your word is truth
questions.explanation: John 17:17 (ESV): "Sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth."

questions.question: Jesus prayed for the disciples and also for those who would believe through their word. What was the core request?
options: that they may all be one, just as the Father is in the Son and the Son in the Father
that they would perform great miracles in every nation
that they would be protected from all physical harm
that they would build a holy temple in Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: that they may all be one, just as the Father is in the Son and the Son in the Father
questions.explanation: John 17:20-21 (ESV): "I do not ask for these only, but also for those who will believe in me through their word, that they may all be one, just as you, Father, are in me, and I in you..."

questions.question: "I in them and you in me, that they may become perfectly one, so that the world may know that you sent me and loved them even as..."?
options: "you loved me."
"you love all creation entirely."
"you love the elect completely."
"you love Israel securely."
questions.explanation: John 17:23 (ESV): "I in them and you in me, that they may become perfectly one, so that the world may know that you sent me and loved them even as you loved me."

questions.question: What did Jesus desire for His disciples at the end of His prayer?
options: "Father, I desire that they also, whom you have given me, may be with me where I am, to see my glory that you have given me because you loved me before the foundation of the world."
"Father, protect them from all evil entirely."
"Father, provide them complete authority over the nations."
"Father, give them wisdom to keep all the commandments."
questions.correctAnswer: "Father, I desire that they also, whom you have given me, may be with me where I am, to see my glory that you have given me because you loved me before the foundation of the world."
questions.explanation: John 17:24 (ESV): "Father, I desire that they also, whom you have given me, may be with me where I am, to see my glory that you have given me because you loved me before the foundation of the world."

questions.question: Jesus described the world as "righteous Father" in contrast to calling God what?
options: The world does not know the Father, but Jesus knows Him
The world loves darkness, but the Father is light
The world loves sin, but the Father is pure
The world is temporary, but the Father is eternal
questions.correctAnswer: The world does not know the Father, but Jesus knows Him
questions.explanation: John 17:25 (ESV): "O righteous Father, even though the world does not know you, I know you, and these know that you have sent me."

questions.question: Jesus stated He had given His disciples the Father's name, and He would continue to make it known. What was His intention?
options: "so that the love with which you have loved me may be in them, and I in them."
"so that they would teach the nations the true Law."
"so that they would gather the lost sheep of Israel."
"so that they would build the eternal kingdom."
questions.correctAnswer: "so that the love with which you have loved me may be in them, and I in them."
questions.explanation: John 17:26 (ESV): "I made known to them your name, and I will continue to make it known, that the love with which you have loved me may be in them, and I in them."

questions.question: Jesus prayed: "I do not ask that you take them out of the world, but that..."?
options: "you keep them from the evil one."
"you bring them swiftly to paradise."
"you shield them with angelic armies."
"you mark them with the seal of heaven."
questions.correctAnswer: "you keep them from the evil one."
questions.explanation: John 17:15 (ESV): "I do not ask that you take them out of the world, but that you keep them from the evil one."

questions.question: What did Jesus say about His disciples: "They are not of the world, even as..."?
options: "I am not of the world."
"the angels are not of the world."
"the prophets were not of the world."
"the Father is not of the world."
questions.explanation: John 17:16 (ESV): "They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world."

questions.question: Jesus said He sent His disciples into the world just as the Father sent Him. Before they were sent, what did He do for them?
options: He consecrated/sanctified himself on their behalf
He taught them all the Scriptures fully
He performed miracles as their final training
He gave them authority over demons
questions.correctAnswer: He consecrated/sanctified himself on their behalf
questions.explanation: John 17:19 (ESV): "And for their sake I consecrate myself, that they also may be sanctified in truth."

questions.question: Jesus prayed that believers would be one so that the world may believe. What was the sign of that unity?
options: That you sent me
That they perform miracles
That they love the Law
That they keep the Sabbath
questions.explanation: John 17:21 (ESV): "...that they may all be one, just as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me."

questions.question: Jesus said the Father loved Him before what event?
options: The foundation of the world
The creation of Adam
The giving of the Law through Moses
The calling of Abraham
questions.explanation: John 17:24 (ESV): "...to see my glory that you have given me because you loved me before the foundation of the world."

key_verse_text: "Sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth."
